concepts.title: Six Limbs of Painting (Shadanga)
concepts.definition: The six essential elements of painting as defined in the Kamasutra, covering aspects from perception and proportion to color analysis and grace.
concepts.formula: shadanga_score = rupabheda + pramana + bhava + lavanya_yojana + sadrishyam + varnikabhanga
concepts.key_idea: A holistic framework for evaluating artistic quality and technique.
question_patterns: what are the six limbs of painting?
list the shadanga elements
define rupabheda and pramana
how is varnikabhanga described in the text?
Explain six limbs of painting (shadanga) in your own words.

solution_steps.explain: The six limbs are Rūpabheda, Pramāṇa, Bhāva, Lāvaṇya yojana, Sādṛśyam, and Varṇikabhaṅga.

concepts.title: Lost Wax Casting Technique
concepts.definition: A metal casting process (cire-perdue) where a wax model is used to create a mold, allowing for intricate bronze sculptures.
concepts.key_idea: An ancient, sophisticated method for creating detailed metal icons.
question_patterns: explain the lost wax technique
what is cire-perdue?
how were bronze sculptures made?
describe the bronze casting process
Explain lost wax casting technique in your own words.

solution_steps.explain: Bronze is an alloy of copper, zinc, and tin.
A wax model is created, covered in clay, and melted out to leave a cavity for molten metal.

concepts.title: Nagara Temple Architecture
concepts.definition: A North Indian temple style characterized by a stone platform, a garbhagriha, and a towering shikhara.
concepts.key_idea: Verticality and geometric progression are core to Nagara design.
question_patterns: what are the features of Nagara architecture?
describe the latina type of shikhara
how does phamsana differ from latina?
what is a valabhi type temple?
Explain nagara temple architecture in your own words.

concepts.title: Dravida Temple Architecture
concepts.definition: A South Indian temple style defined by a walled compound, a monumental gopuram entrance, and a stepped-pyramid vimana.
concepts.key_idea: Emphasis on horizontal enclosure and pyramidal verticality.
question_patterns: how does the Dravida style differ from Nagara?
what is a gopuram?
describe the vimana in Dravida temples
identify key features of Chola temple architecture
Explain dravida temple architecture in your own words.

solution_steps.explain: Dravida uses compound walls and stepped pyramids, unlike the curved Nagara shikhara.
